name: Crontab Generator
description: Build a five-field crontab expression and preview the next trigger times.

examples.label: Half past two on the 15th of each month

hints.preset: With a preset the five time fields are ignored.
hints.fields: The fields are minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week; *, a, a-b, */n and comma lists are supported.
hints.timezone: Use an IANA name such as Asia/Shanghai; an empty value means UTC.
hints.output: Trigger times are listed in the selected timezone, in RFC 3339 format.

faq.q: How are day of month and day of week combined?
faq.a: They are combined with a union, following the traditional crontab semantics: a match on either field triggers the job.

faq.q: Can I write 7 for the day of week?
Does this tool produce the command to run?
faq.a: No. It only produces the time expression; it neither interprets the command part nor performs any safety assessment.
